Drive the improvement and standardization of financial processes, coordinating the different subsidiaries and contributing to the optimization of the Group's financial performance. We are looking for someone who makes things happen: opening doors, understanding customer problems, shaping proposals, and turning opportunities into signed contracts. You will also help develop how we go to market, opening channels, building partnerships, and testing ways to reach customers. You will work directly with the founders, who set the overall business direction and support you on deals. Together, you will identify the segments and opportunities worth pursuing. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role with responsibility for the commercial function. You will have the autonomy to build your own sales playbook, supported by the founders and technical team. We expect you to take ownership of closing business from the outset. What you will do Own the full sales cycle, from identifying and prospecting accounts through negotiation, close, and expansion. Build and execute outbound and partnership strategies, generating your own pipeline. Sell both existing AI solutions and custom projects, adapting the approach to each customer’s needs. Work directly with business and technical stakeholders to understand their operations, ask the right questions, and shape a solution with our engineering team. Build clear business cases that connect the proposed solution to the customer’s priorities and expected return. Land accounts with a focused use case and expand them into broader, higher-value relationships. Help define priority segments, test messaging and channels, and turn what works into a repeatable commercial process. Maintain a clear view of pipeline, next steps, and forecasts, reporting directly to the founders. Meet prospects and clients in person when it helps move the relationship forward. What we are looking for At least 3 years of experience in B2B technology sales, with a demonstrated ability to generate opportunities and close business. A hands-on profile who can take responsibility for a deal from first contact to signed contract. Experience in consultative selling. Technical fluency and curiosity. The more you understand AI, software, APIs, and integrations, the better. You will have direct support from the founders and engineering team to deepen that knowledge. Commercial judgement: you know how to qualify an opportunity, identify decision-makers, handle objections, and negotiate. Professional fluency in Spanish and English. Availability to work in a hybrid setup in Madrid and travel to meet prospects and customers. Your background could include: Account executive roles at early-stage technology companies, particularly where you helped open a market or build the sales process. Business development or technology consulting roles with direct responsibility for winning business. Entrepreneurship, where you built an offering, found customers, and closed sales yourself. Across these backgrounds, we are looking for evidence that you can sell and close. Bonus points Experience selling AI solutions, technical services, or custom development projects. Experience building a commercial function or opening a new market. An existing network of potential customers or partners in Spain, Europe, or Latin America. Early-stage startup or founder experience. What we offer Ownership of commercial execution and a direct role in building Menhir’s growth. Close collaboration with the founders and technical team. Autonomy to develop channels, test ideas, and build your own sales approach. Exposure to applied AI across different business problems and industries. Hybrid working in Madrid. Competitive salary. Uncapped commission on signed contracts. Private health insurance

review_candidates.title: Embedded Software Engineering
review_candidates.description: In Capgemini Engineering, leader mondiale nei servizi di ingegneria, uniamo un team globale di talenti dell’ingegneria, scienza e tecnologia per aiutare le aziende più innovative del mondo a liberare il loro potenziale. Dai veicoli autonomi ai robot salva-vita, le nostre persone esperte in tecnologia digitale e software pensano fuori dagli schemi, offrendo servizi unici di ricerca e sviluppo e ingegneria in tutti i settori. Unisciti a noi per una carriera ricca di opportunità, dove potrai fare la differenza, in un ambiente in cui ogni giorno è unico. IL TUO RUOLO Come Embedded Software Engineer presso Capgemini Engineering, lavorerai presso il nostro team globale nelle seguenti aree di competenza: Embedded Low Level Development Embedded Applications Development Embedded Safety Critical Software Development Embedded Model Driven Development Embedded Verification & Validation Nel nostro Centro Tecnologico Embedded Software Engineering ci occupiamo di: Sviluppo a basso livello per prodotti embedded, come driver e firmware; Sviluppo di applicazioni per prodotti embedded, come sistemi infotainment; Sviluppo software per sistemi critici per la sicurezza o che richiedono conformità alle normative; Attività di verifica e validazione per prodotti embedded, come test unitari, test di integrazione, test di sistema e test di accettazione. LE TUE CARATTERISTICHE Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria Informatica, Embedded Systems, Elettronica o affini; Esperienza pregressa nei campi di applicazione Embedded Software; Esperienza e dimestichezza con i linguaggi di programmazione C e C++; Capacità di lavorare in team con un approccio collaborativo e orientato al miglioramento continuo delle soluzioni progettuali; Conoscenza dell’inglese tecnico. N.B.: Le opportunità disponibili coprono una vasta gamma di settori, tra cui Aerospaziale e Difesa, Ferroviario, Automotive, Manufacturing Industriale, Life Sciences e Transizione Energetica e Utilities, Prodotti di consumo, Retail & Distribution, Telecomunicazioni, Technology & Digital. Ogni settore offre sfide stimolanti, con l'opportunità di contribuire a soluzioni innovative e sostenibili in un ambiente dinamico. PERCHÉ TI PIACERÀ LAVORARE CON NOI Riconosciamo l’importanza di soluzioni di lavoro flessibili per offrirti supporto. Che si tratti di lavoro da remoto, orari flessibili o entrambi, troverai un ambiente che favorisce l’equilibrio tra vita privata e vita lavorativa; Al centro della nostra missione c'è la tua carriera, attraverso percorsi di crescita professionale pensati per supportarti nell'esplorare un mondo di opportunità; Ci impegniamo a promuovere la responsabilità sociale creando un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, dove talenti diversi sono valorizzati. La diversità è un pilastro della nostra cultura aziendale, arricchendo il nostro lavoro attraverso esperienze, culture, etnie, stili di comunicazione e comportamenti. Avrai l’opportunità di sviluppare software embedded per sistemi ad alta complessità tecnologica, lavorando su tecnologie come C/C++, CUDA, Model-Based Design e Qt in contesti innovativi e sfidanti. Potrai confrontarti con sistemi real-time, architetture avanzate e soluzioni ad alte prestazioni, sperimentare nuovi strumenti e metodologie di sviluppo e accedere a percorsi di certificazione dedicati che ti permetteranno di crescere rapidamente come professionista, dalla specializzazione tecnica fino a possibili evoluzioni verso ruoli di Tech Lead, Software Architect o System Architect. Location: sede di assunzione Roma, Milano, Torino, Firenze, Genova La Spezia, Bologna, Modena, Padova e Napoli in modalità di lavoro ibrida/in sede. Tipo di contratto: contratto a tempo indeterminato Inquadramento: CCNL Commercio – 3 Livello/2 Livello/1 Livello Mansione: Associate Software Engineer/ Software Engineer/ Senior Software Engineer Retribuzione annua lorda (RAL): da € 27,746 a € 30,825 per il 3° livello da € 31,270 a € 40,150 per il 2° livello da € 35,057 a € 57,475 per il 1° livello La fascia retributiva indicata è definita in conformità alla normativa europea e nazionale in materia di trasparenza retributiva. Il valore minimo della fascia corrisponde al trattamento economico minimo previsto dal CCNL applicabile per il livello e mansione sopra indicati e non rappresenta necessariamente la retribuzione di ingresso. La retribuzione che sarà proposta all’esito del processo di selezione sarà determinata sulla base delle competenze, dell’esperienza professionale, del livello di seniority e delle caratteristiche specifiche del profilo selezionato ed in coerenza con il sistema retributivo e di classificazione aziendale, nel rispetto di criteri oggettivi e neutri sotto il profilo del genere. SUL GRUPPO CAPGEMINI Capgemini è il partner per la trasformazione aziendale nell'era dell'AI. Aiutiamo le organizzazioni a immaginare e costruire un futuro intelligente e sostenibile, combinando AI, tecnologia e ingegno umano per trasformare il modo in cui operano, innovano e crescono. Grazie a competenze end-to-end che spaziano dalla strategia alla tecnologia, dall'ingegneria alle operations intelligenti, combiniamo una profonda conoscenza dei settori industriali con competenze all'avanguardia in ambito AI, cloud e dati, trasformando le ambizioni in risultati di business misurabili e scalabili. Supportata da un solido ecosistema di partner e forte di quasi 60 anni di esperienza, Capgemini è un'azienda globale responsabile e diversificata composta da oltre 410.000 persone in più di 50 paesi. Nel 2025 il Gruppo ha registrato ricavi complessivi pari a 22,5 miliardi di euro. Make it real | www.capgemini.com Candidati ora! L'offerta di lavoro si intende rivolta all'uno e all'altro sesso in ottemperanza al D.Lgs. 198/2006. Inoltre, prestiamo attenzione e sensibilità alle future risorse appartenenti alle categorie protette, ai sensi degli articoli 1 e 18 della legge 68 del ‘99. I dati personali saranno trattati in conformità alle disposizioni contenute nel regolamento UE 2016/679.

review_candidates.title: Director of Engineering
review_candidates.description: Director of Engineering Build and scale engineering for automated aerospace and defense manufacturing | $200,000–$350,000 base + equity We’re looking for a Director of Engineering to build and scale the software organisation at a fast-growing company operating its own automated factories for the aerospace and defense industries. The company has grown from $0 to $14 million in revenue in its first year and is well funded. This is an opportunity to join at a pivotal stage, shape the engineering organisation, and apply advanced technology to complex, real-world manufacturing challenges. We’re looking for a hands-on engineering leader who can set technical direction, build a high-performing team, and remain deeply involved in architecture and software development. You’ll work closely with the CEO and factory teams, connecting software decisions directly to operational outcomes. What you’ll do Build and scale the engineering organisation as the company expands. Define the software architecture and technical standards needed to support growth. Lead, mentor, and recruit high-performing engineers, drawing on your existing network. Remain hands-on with system design, coding, and critical technical decisions. Apply advanced technologies, including AI, machine learning, optimisation, and data systems, to manufacturing and industrial challenges. Work closely with factory-floor teams to turn operational needs into robust software solutions. Drive engineering execution, balancing speed, reliability, and long-term scalability. What we’re looking for Approximately 5–10 years of engineering experience, including meaningful technical leadership and team-scaling responsibility. Experience applying frontier technology, such as AI or another breakthrough technology, at scale within a company that has demonstrated significant success. A track record of helping grow an engineering team while establishing or shaping the underlying architecture. Strong software engineering and system-design skills, with the ability and willingness to continue coding. Experience building production systems involving machine learning, optimisation, data products, or complex software platforms. The ability to recruit strong engineers and attract talent through an established professional network. A hands-on leadership style: comfortable moving between architecture discussions, code reviews, hiring, and the factory floor. Willingness to work in person in Los Angeles, with existing US work authorisation and no need for visa sponsorship. Experience in manufacturing, aerospace, defense, robotics, logistics, or industrial software is particularly valuable. Candidates from high-performing technology and hardware organisations who have transitioned into software leadership may be especially relevant. Why join? Build the organisation: Shape the engineering team, culture, architecture, and technical roadmap. Solve consequential problems: Develop software for automated factories supporting aerospace and defense. Join a proven growth story: Help scale a well-funded company that reached $14 million in revenue in its first year. Stay technically involved: Combine leadership and hiring with architecture and hands-on engineering. Make a direct impact: Work closely with the CEO and factory teams, with a clear connection between engineering and business outcomes. Location and compensation Location: Los Angeles, California — in person. Working schedule: 9-9-5. Experience: Approximately 5–10 years. Base salary: $200,000–$350,000, depending on experience and fit. Equity: 0.1–1%. Visa sponsorship: Not available. Interview process Initial conversation with the hiring lead. An in-person day in Los Angeles, including dinner, time on the factory floor, and a working session with the CEO. Offer. Interested in building an engineering organisation where software meets advanced manufacturing? If you’ve helped a successful technology company scale, can attract exceptional engineers, and want to lead without stepping away from the technical work, this could be an excellent next step.

review_candidates.description: We’re Hiring: Data Analyst at the State Comptroller and Ombudsman of Israel About Us The Office of the State Comptroller and Ombudsman is Israel's supreme audit institution, dedicated to ensuring government accountability, efficiency, and integrity. By joining us, you will play a key role in advancing data-driven decision-making that directly impacts the public sector and serves the citizens of Israel. About the Role As a Data Analyst in our Professional Support Division, you will turn complex data into actionable insights that shape organizational strategy. You will be at the forefront of building our data capabilities, from analysis and visualization to implementing cutting-edge Big Data and AI tools. This is a unique opportunity to drive meaningful change within a vital public institution. What you’ll do: Lead quantitative and qualitative analysis to support strategic and operational processes. Collect, clean, and analyze data from diverse sources, communicating findings through effective BI dashboards and visualizations. Help select and implement advanced technological tools for data analysis. Develop and deliver data analytics training to empower colleagues across the organization. Establish the professional and technological infrastructure required to manage and process Big Data and integrate AI tools into our workflows. Job Requirements: Education (One of the following): Option 1: A Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field like Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or Industrial Engineering (or an equivalent combination of education and professional training). Option 2: A Bachelor's degree in any field, together with at least 200 hours of professional coursework in data analytics or data mining, completed as part of an academic program or through another educational framework. At least 2 years of hands-on experience in data analytics or data mining. Strong analytical thinking, intellectual curiosity, and self-learning capabilities. Excellent communication skills in Hebrew (both written and verbal). Big Advantages: We are looking for candidates who bring a unique blend of technical skills and a passion for public service. Strengths that will set you apart include: Practical experience with Python, R, or SQL . Proven expertise with BI tools, especially Power BI . Familiarity with GIS and experience using AI tools for data analytics. Experience working in a public-sector, government, or military organization. What Success Looks Like: Success in this role means becoming a go-to expert for data insights, proactively identifying opportunities to use data for improvement, and effectively empowering your colleagues to become more data-literate. You will see your work directly contribute to building a more efficient and data-centric organization. Want to learn more? Join our virtual information session on October 25, 2026, at 14:00 to hear more about the role and our organization. Register here: Link to Information Session Ready to make an impact? Apply now! https://tinyurl.com/5fue8aw6 דרוש/ה: Data Analyst במשרד מבקר המדינה ונציב תלונות הציבור אודותינו משרד מבקר המדינה ונציב תלונות הציבור הוא מוסד הביקורת העליון של מדינת ישראל, הפועל כשומר סף על מנת להבטיח שהגופים הציבוריים פועלים על פי החוק, תוך שמירה על טוהר המידות, מינהל תקין, יעילות וחיסכון. הצטרפות אלינו היא הזדמנות לקחת חלק מרכזי בקידום קבלת החלטות מבוססת נתונים המשפיעה באופן ישיר על שיפור המגזר הציבורי ומשרתת את אזרחי המדינה. על התפקיד כאנליסט/ית נתונים באגף לתמיכה מקצועית, תהפוך/י נתונים מורכבים לתובנות מעשיות המעצבות את האסטרטגיה של הארגון. תוביל/י את פיתוח יכולות הנתונים שלנו – החל מניתוח וויזואליזציה ועד להטמעת כלי Big Data ובינה מלאכותית מתקדמים. זוהי הזדמנות ייחודית להוביל שינוי משמעותי בתוך מוסד ציבורי חיוני. מה תעשה/י במסגרת התפקיד: תוביל/י ניתוחים כמותיים ואיכותיים לתמיכה בתהליכי ביקורת אסטרטגיים ותפעוליים. תאסוף/י, תנתח/י ותטייב/י נתונים ממקורות מגוונים, ותציג/י את הממצאים באמצעות לוחות בקרה (BI Dashboards) וויזואליזציות אפקטיביות. תסייע/י בבחירה ובהטמעה של כלים טכנולוגיים מתקדמים לניתוח נתונים. תפתח/י ותעביר/י הכשרות בתחום ה-Data במטרה להעצים את עמיתייך למקצוע ברחבי הארגון. תבנה/י את התשתית המקצועית והטכנולוגית הנדרשת לניהול ועיבוד Big Data ושילוב כלי AI בתהליכי העבודה שלנו. דרישות התפקיד: השכלה (אחת מהאפשרויות הבאות): אפשרות 1: תואר ראשון בתחום כמותי כגון מדעי המחשב, מדע הנתונים (Data Science), סטטיסטיקה או הנדסת תעשייה וניהול (או שילוב שווה ערך של השכלה והכשרה מקצועית). אפשרות 2: תואר ראשון בכל תחום שהוא, לצד לפחות 200 שעות של קורסים מקצועיים בתחום אנליזת הנתונים (Data Analytics) או כריית נתונים (Data Mining), אשר הושלמו במסגרת אקדמית או במסגרת הכשרה מקצועית אחרת. לפחות שנתיים של ניסיון מעשי באנליזת נתונים או כריית נתונים. חשיבה אנליטית חזקה, סקרנות אינטלקטואלית ויכולת למידה עצמית גבוהה. כישורי תקשורת מעולים בעברית (בכתב ובעל פה). יתרונות משמעותיים: אנו מחפשים מועמדים/ות שמביאים שילוב ייחודי של יכולות טכניות ותשוקה לעשייה ציבורית. חוזקות שיעניקו לך יתרון: ניסיון מעשי ב- Python, R או SQL . מומחיות מוכחת בכלי BI, בפרט Power BI . The supervisor inspects containers to identify defects, determines repair methods, and verifies the quality of completed work, maintaining accurate records of maintenance, parts usage, and repair costs. Previous experience in container depots, terminals, or logistics is preferred. Must be a resident of Suez.
